snippet.title: Passing Pineview Forest
snippet.description:
A small free game production that supports Oculus Rift (DK2) playing in the Pineview Drive universe. A version without Oculus Rift is also available! You can find the free download-links on our facebook pages:

https://www.facebook.com/pages/Passing-Pineview-Forest/773972369326562?ref=hl
https://www.facebook.com/PineviewDrive?ref=hl

Download links:
-Normal version:
http://vis-games.de.www254.your-server.de/vis-games/downloads/PassingPVD/PassingPineviewForestNonRift.zip

System Requirements:
----------------------------
-Windows with Direct 9.0c
-CPU with 2.8GHz
-Graphics Adapter generation nVidia GeForce GTX 570
-RAM 4 GB

-Oculus Rift version:
http://vis-games.de.www254.your-server.de/vis-games/downloads/PassingPVD/PassingPineviewForestDK2.zip

Min.System Requirements:
--------------------
-Oculus Rift (DK2)
-Windows with Direct X11
-CPU with 3.4GHz
-Graphics Adapter generation nVidia GeForce GTX 780
-RAM 4 GB
